Title: Chicken Satay Tray Bake with Potatoes (Facebook Reel)

Items: 800 g chicken thigh fillets, cut into bite-size pieces
700 g potatoes, cut into 2-3 cm chunks

Preparation: Parboil 700 g potatoes in salted water for 8-10 minutes. Drain, steam dry, and cool.
Cut 800 g chicken thigh fillets into bite-size pieces.
Add the chicken, potatoes, peppers, and red onion to a large bowl or roasting tray.
Mix 1 tbsp red curry paste, 1 tsp curry powder, juice of 1/2 lime, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 120 ml coconut milk.
Pour over the tray ingredients and mix well.
Mix 1 tbsp red curry paste, 3 tbsp peanut butter, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cm fresh ginger, juice of 1/2 lime, 1/2 tbsp fish sauce, and 80 ml coconut milk until smooth.
Slice 1 spring onion, chop 1 handful fresh coriander, and slice 1-2 red chillies.
Cooking: Add the satay sauce mixture and mix well.
Bake for 5-10 minutes until the sauce bubbles and the chicken is cooked through.
Top with spring onion, coriander, and red chillies. Serve.
OptionalInstructions: If the satay sauce is too thick, mix in 1-2 tbsp water before adding it to the tray.
If cooking from chilled, add 3-5 minutes to the first bake.
If skipping the parboil, roast the potatoes for 15 minutes before adding the chicken and other tray bake ingredients.
Customizations: Add 50-100 ml extra coconut milk to the satay sauce for a looser sauce.
Add 1-2 tsp honey or brown sugar to the satay sauce for a sweeter flavour.
Use baby potatoes, halved, instead of chopped potatoes.
ServingSuggestions: Serve with jasmine rice or basmati rice.
